title: GTA 6 free codes: Kick and Twitch giveaways before launch
description: GTA 6 free codes are coming from Kick and Twitch before the November 19 launch. Here is how each giveaway works and what we still don't know.

body.text: Kick and Twitch are both running GTA 6 promotions ahead of Rockstar's November 19 launch, and each gives stream viewers a shot at a free copy, according to Dexerto. Kick has put 10,000 GTA 6 Ultimate Edition codes into a reward campaign, while Twitch has promised daily code drops without saying how many. For anyone hoping to land GTA 6 free codes, both are worth knowing about.
GTA 6 free codes on Kick: how to enter
Kick's campaign is called the Sunset Reward Case. It started on November 12 and runs through December 7, per Dexerto.
To take part, you need to:

items: Sign in to Kick or open the app
Open the case that appears beside your avatar

body.text: A code is not guaranteed with each case. You can unlock another case each day, and new users can get a free entry case once they finish onboarding.

Kick's terms list 10,000 digital codes for the GTA 6 Ultimate Edition, on PS5 or Xbox Series X|S. Xbox codes are available worldwide, subject to Microsoft's platform restrictions. PS5 codes only work in supported PlayStation Network regions, so Indian viewers should check their region before spending hours on a stream. The codes will not be issued before the game launches on November 19.
Kick says no purchase, subscription, deposit, wager or betting is needed to enter. It also says the promotion is run independently and is not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two Interactive.
Twitch revealed its plans at the TwitchCon San Diego 2026 opening ceremony. From launch through November 30, it will offer several GTA 6-themed rewards, including new emotes and badges.

The platform also said it will do daily drops of GTA 6 game codes from launch through the end of November "to show appreciation." GTA 6 streams will get a HEIST-themed version of Hype Trains too, with six exclusive emotes during participating broadcasts.

Twitch's announcement leaves several gaps. It did not give the total number of codes, say whether viewers must hit a certain watch time, or name which channels will take part. Until Twitch publishes those details, treat the drops as a bonus rather than something to plan around.

Kick is also pushing the campaign offline. It has a truck-sized version of its loot case driving around Los Angeles, with a Lucia cosplayer at the wheel and a QR code linking to the campaign. Kick says the truck will travel through wider California during the promotion.

The big date is November 19, when GTA 6 launches on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. That is also when Kick's codes become eligible to be issued and when Twitch's daily drops begin. Watch for Twitch to share how many codes are up for grabs and how viewers can qualify, and read the full terms on both platforms before you start. Kick's campaign closes on December 7, while Twitch's drops are set to run only through the end of November.

faqs.q: How do I get GTA 6 free codes on Kick?
faqs.a: According to Dexerto, you sign in to Kick or open the app, watch any livestream for 180 minutes, then open the Sunset Reward Case beside your avatar. A code is a chance, not a guarantee.

faqs.q: When does GTA 6 launch and on which platforms?
faqs.a: Dexerto reports that GTA 6 launches on November 19 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar lists that date on its official GTA 6 website.

faqs.q: How many GTA 6 codes is Twitch giving away?
faqs.a: Twitch has not said. It announced daily code drops from launch through the end of November, but it did not reveal the total number of codes, any watch-time requirement or which channels will take part.

sources.title: Kick and Twitch are giving away thousands of GTA 6 codes to viewers before launch
